task.description: Identifier of the task, such as SHOP-1.

return.description: The return the decision allows, after the record; only with allow_return.

node.description: Node the return is from: the current node of the task.

to.description: Node the return goes back to.

returns.description: Returns made by the transition, counted anew after a return by an outer loop.

max_returns.description: Limit of returns by the transition with the returns the operator allowed.

allowed_returns.description: Returns of the limit the operator allowed beyond the flow.
